firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a full moon starts.

editionLabel: English rules in the eight-page publisher-linked PDF
location: How to Play, choosing the first active player
firstPlayerRule: The group's greatest adventurer takes the first turn.
officialTieBreak: If you are unsure who that is, the player who most recently went hiking starts.
clarifications: The active player rolls the dice and selects a color-and-number pair first. The other players then choose from the remaining dice.

editionLabel: English Thames & Kosmos rules, eight-page publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently saw a cathedral starts the first round.
clarifications: This chooses the initial starting player, who receives the cathedral's nave piece.
evidenceNotes: The printed page number is 2, while its position in the downloaded PDF is 3.

editionLabel: English Thames & Kosmos rules, six-page spread PDF
location: Preparation, starting-player instruction on the right-hand page
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently ate dates goes first.
officialTieBreak: If neither player has ever eaten dates, the player using blue starts.
evidenceNotes: The fallback applies when neither player has eaten dates; the source does not state a separate tie-break for both having eaten them together.
